fact: ZIMSTAT (Zimbabwe National Statistics Agency) states that the OpenSDG portal, a hub for national SDG indicators giving the public access to Zimbabwe's SDG progress, was officially launched on 9 July 2025.
ZIMSTAT's guide for its Open Data Portal (ODP 2.0) describes a public frontend at zw.dbr.afdb.org where published datasets and dashboards are visible, from a workshop of 13-17 October 2025.
